rows.title: Method: what this week's analysis should look at (playbook-informed)
rows.question: What should this week's analysis look at?
rows.reply:
I'd run the weekly ASXR cycle: pull the numbers per channel from source of truth first, then decide what they mean. For you that's Shopify and GA4 (both ok), plus Instagram for content performance — Meta Ads, Google Ads and Klaviyo are off or expired, so I'd flag those as blocked rather than pretend there's fresh data there.

Concretely I'd look at: email share of revenue (22%, up 3 pts — worth asking why and whether it holds), repeat purchase rate (14%, flat against your 22% goal — that gap is the real story), and content output from the founder content engine since that's phase 1 of your plan. I'd skip paid analysis beyond the one pending approval, since Meta and Google Ads aren't connected and retargeting frequency (4.1) is the only live signal there.

If you want, I'll write up the four-level channel breakdown — what happened, what it means, what's broken, what to test next — using just these numbers, and surface it before Friday's review.

judge.rationale: Correctly names ASXR, uses only real numbers (22%, 14%, 4.1), flags disconnected connectors honestly, and ends with one clear next step; doesn't touch pace gap or budget move but no invented figures.
